writer_data.question: A study guide comparing the approved mission and station schedules, sensor inventories, lead names and the station's planned power.

evidence.title: mission-en.md
evidence.quote:
Revision: 1. Approved on September 20, 2030.
The Marigold mission is scheduled to launch on October 18, 2030.
It carries three environmental sensors. Its approved budget is USD 120,000.
The mission lead is Mira Chen. The destination is Europa.
The plan does not identify a sponsor. The launch has not happened yet.

evidence.title: station-ru.md
evidence.quote:
Утверждено 21 сентября 2030 года.
Открытие станции «Лис» назначено на 12 ноября 2030 года.
На станции будет семь датчиков температуры. Руководитель — Алина Морозова.
Плановая мощность станции составляет 40 киловатт.
Фактические результаты работы ещё не получены.

items.text: The Marigold mission was approved on September 20, 2030, and is scheduled to launch on October 18, 2030.
The Station Lis approved plan was finalized on September 21, 2030, with an opening scheduled for November 12, 2030.
The Marigold mission carries three environmental sensors.
Station Lis will have seven temperature sensors.
Mira Chen is the lead for the Marigold mission.
Alina Morozova is the lead for Station Lis.
The planned power for Station Lis is 40 kilowatts.
